snippet.title: Void Nebula – First Look Trailer
snippet.description:
→ Wishlist Void Nebula on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4212830/Void_Nebula
→ Join the Discord : https://discord.gg/Hu3WXgQHnK

Void Nebula is a deckbuilding roguelike inspired by Balatro, Cobalt Core and Slay the Spire. Even if the game is still in early development, I feel like I can show it to you all.

The game's first inspiration is Balatro. The game loop is really similar: you fight one enemy and proceed to the shop, do this 3×8 times and you beat the game! I wanted to mix the feel of Balatro with the fighting system of Slay the Spire and the item system of Risk of Rain 2, also.
